renderer: Chromium with requested SwiftShader launch flags
checks: the isolated garden renders and advances
moving between holders retains the same renderer
drag adjusts the view within a small range
an out-and-back drag never emits a touch event
the keyboard-accessible nearby glow control starts a local response
reduced motion keeps a still, rendered garden
motion resumes after the preference is restored
the visibility handler resumes the scene
viewport visibility resumes the same scene
portrait resize retains a bounded raster buffer
fold-portrait redraws a still at the requested aspect
fold-landscape redraws a still at the requested aspect
a separate DPR 2 portrait context renders a capped reduced-motion still
limitations: Behavior checks run at800×500 to keep software rasterization practical; separate full-size capture uses1280×800.

Software rendering verifies behavior and output, not native-GPU frame rate or battery usage.
Behavior and screenshots use device scale factor 1; a separate initially-still portrait context checks device scale factor 2.
Telemetry and screenshots do not establish visual quality; review the saved desktop and portrait images separately.
